customer_acme: Hey team — our Private deployment (eu-central) started returning intermittent 502s and large tail latencies around 2025-11-12T15:04Z. Two example request IDs: req-0a12b3c4, req-0a12b3c5. Also seeing a billing spike (INV-9981). We can't share unredacted bundles because of PCI data, need guidance on repro and safe debug bundle flow.

carol_support: Sorry about that — we'll help. Can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces the 502 and the x-request-id header? Also we'll need a redacted debug bundle from your collector (instructions below).

customer_acme: Reproducer (this triggers a 502 within ~10s):
```
curl -v 'https://private-api.acme.internal/v1/generate' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'x-request-id: req-0a12b3c4' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rw-internal-13b","input":"hello"}'
```

jon_prod_eng: Thanks. From the snippets we've seen in other tenants, 502+latency here often points to upstream TLS handshakes failing intermittently (envoy->upstream) or the collector upload path being delayed by a corporate proxy. Can you capture the tail of the collector log around the failing request and the runtime trace id (if present)? e.g., look for lines containing "trace=" or "span=".

maya_cts: When we tried to upload a bundle earlier we hit TLS cert errors behind our customer's proxy: collector.log had: "[collector] ERROR tls handshake: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority; trace=trc-9f8e7d". Also saw: "redactor: unknown rule 'cc_number' in redactor.yaml" — which caused partial redaction.

sam_ops: If presigned HTTPS uploads fail due to corporate MITM, fallback flow: upload encrypted archive to your bastion via scp/rsync, we'll pull from there. Example: `scp /tmp/acme-debug.enc ops@bastion.internal:/incoming/support/acme/` — we will then rsync into our secure bucket.

carol_support: To generate a minimal, safe debug bundle for Private deploys: run on the collector host:
```
REDACT_DEBUG=1 collector debug-bundle \n  --include-logs \n  --include-config \n  --redact-level=partial \n  --out=/tmp/acme-debug.tar.gz
```
Then run a local sanity redact check (this won't upload):
```
collector redact-check --input /tmp/acme-debug.tar.gz --rules /etc/redwood/redactor.yaml
```
If that passes, encrypt and transfer: `openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 100000 -salt -in /tmp/acme-debug.tar.gz -out /tmp/acme-debug.enc` and scp to bastion. We'll provide a one-time passphrase via secure channel.

customer_acme: note: our redactor.yaml was custom and removed PAN numbers but left Authorization headers in traces. I can patch the rule, but worried about leaving customer tokens. What exact fields do you need?

carol_support: We need: collector.log (last 5k), /etc/redwood/collector.conf, /etc/redwood/redactor.yaml, a single curl reproducer (the one you already posted), and the billing invoice lines (INV-9981) — please redact full card numbers; we only need invoice ids and the last 4 of API keys (e.g., sk-****1234).

jon_prod_eng: If you see the x509 handshake error, also run: `openssl s_client -connect upload.support.internal:443 -servername upload.support.internal -showcerts` on the collector host and paste output (redact cert blocks if needed). For a quick workaround, set a temporary upload method in collector.conf: `upload_method = scp` and `sftp_host = bastion.internal` and increase `sftp_timeout = 120`. Do NOT set TLS_VERIFY=false globally — only use that as a last-resort troubleshooting toggle and only for the upload host.

customer_acme: Understood. We'll produce the redacted bundle and SCP it to bastion. Also attaching the small tail of collector.log we grabbed: 
```
[2025-11-12T15:03:57Z] [collector] INFO starting bundle generation id=bundle-1
[2025-11-12T15:04:05Z] [collector] WARN upload retry 1 err="tls handshake: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" trace=trc-9f8e7d
[2025-11-12T15:04:15Z] [collector] ERROR upload failed err="net/http: TLS handshake timeout"
```

carol_support: Perfect, that's helpful. Once you SCP the encrypted bundle to the bastion path above, reply here with the filename and timestamp and we'll pick it up. Also include the reproducer curl and the billing invoice lines. I'll open an internal high-priority ticket and loop in SRE for the TLS cert mystery.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy started 2025-11-12T15:10Z (sha: abcdef123456). Noted for context; not suspected to be the root cause.

sam_ops: FYI we had a recent root CA rotation in our upload fleet last week — SRE will confirm if that affects customers behind TLS-intercepting proxies.

carol_support: Thanks everyone. customer_acme — once you upload, ping here with `uploaded: /incoming/support/acme/acme-debug-2355550000.enc` and we'll proceed. If upload cannot reach bastion, we can provide an sftp drop and presigned URL via our support portal as a fallback (but presign can fail with MITM).

customer_acme: Uploaded now: /incoming/support/acme/acme-debug-2355550000.enc — scp finished at 2025-11-12T15:26Z. Shipping passphrase via secure ticket. We'll follow up with the invoice lines and the small reproducer curl.

carol_support: Got it, marking high-priority and confirming the ticket. We'll keep this thread for follow-ups. :pray:
